name: Photographe de Teyvat/19.01.2023
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ Following Jeht's footsteps, you must have arrived at the Tanit Camps, before continuing on, deeper and deeper, into the desert. On the way through the Desert of Hadramaveth, were you fascinated by the various ingenious devices and was tempted to explore them? Share the secret mechanisms with me in the form of photos!
